name: ThermalState
description: State containing quantities for thermal physics.

attributes.name: temp
attributes.description: temperature of the body

attributes.name: oldTemp
attributes.description: change of temp (for thermal expansion)

attributes.name: stepFlux
attributes.description: flux during current step

attributes.name: thermalMass
attributes.description: mass of the body used for thermal calculations

attributes.name: Cp
attributes.description: Heat capacity of the body

attributes.name: k
attributes.description: thermal conductivity of the body

attributes.name: alpha
attributes.description: coefficient of thermal expansion

attributes.name: Tcondition
attributes.description: indicates if particle is assigned dirichlet (constant temp) condition

attributes.name: boundaryId
attributes.description: identifies if a particle is associated with constant temperature thrermal boundary condition

attributes.name: stabilityCoefficient
attributes.description: sum of solid and fluid thermal resistivities for use in automatic timestep estimation

attributes.name: delRadius
attributes.description: radius change due to thermal expansion

attributes.name: isCavity
attributes.description: flag used for unbounding cavity bodies

attributes.name: se3
attributes.description: Position and orientation as one object.

attributes.name: vel
attributes.description: Current linear velocity.

attributes.name: mass
attributes.description: Mass of this body

attributes.name: angVel
attributes.description: Current angular velocity

attributes.name: angMom
attributes.description: Current angular momentum

attributes.name: inertia
attributes.description: Inertia of associated body, in local coordinate system.

attributes.name: refPos
attributes.description: Reference position

attributes.name: refOri
attributes.description: Reference orientation

attributes.name: blockedDOFs
attributes.description: Degress of freedom where linear/angular velocity will be always constant (equal to zero, or to an user-defined value), regardless of applied force/torque. String that may contain 'xyzXYZ' (translations and rotations).

attributes.name: isDamped
attributes.description: Damping in NewtonIntegrator can be deactivated for individual particles by setting this variable to FALSE. E.g. damping is inappropriate for particles in free flight under gravity but it might still be applicable to other particles in the same simulation.

attributes.name: densityScaling
attributes.description: Multiplicative coefficient to reflect an artificial change in mass density (as per GlobalStiffnessTimeStepper.targetDt) which NewtonIntegrator (depending on the corresponding option NewtonIntegrator.densityScaling) will reflect into linear and angular velocities (but not angular momentum that still corresponds to the unbiaised inertia tensor) as a multiplicative coefficient (auto-updated).

attributes.name: dispIndex
attributes.description: Return class index of this instance.

attributes.name: pos
attributes.description: Current position.

attributes.name: ori
attributes.description: Current orientation as the quaternion-form of the rotation that maps the model, i.e. global, coordinate system into an inertial, i.e. local, basis for the body.

methods.name: dispHierarchy
methods.description: Return list of dispatch classes (from down upwards), starting with the class instance itself, top-level indexable at last. If names is true (default), return class names rather than numerical indices.

methods.name: rot
methods.description: Rotation from reference orientation<State.refOri> (as rotation vector)

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
